video_title: Reacting to Luka Doncic prefering to play with Austin Reaves over Giannis 🤯

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves is amazing, but AJ Mitchell is better
quotes.quote: Austin Rivers is a amazing player. I mean, Austin Reaves. Austin Reaves is an amazing player. I think if he was healthy, his performance might have been better. But he did show glimpse of what he can do, who he is. He's going to get his $200-some million. He's going to get that. But AJ Mitchell, way better than him this series.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers must trade Austin Reaves for Paul George if LeBron stays
quotes.quote: If they keep LeBron James, you can't keep them three again this year. You have to go get something else with those guys. And I hate, I know y'all hate me when I say this, send Austin Reaves over there with them young boys in Philly. Go get PG. PG's making a lot of money. PG signed for $200-some million, I know that, right? Which is what Austin is going to sign for. It's $200. Paul George is making over $200 million. Didn't he sign for $200?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka preferring Austin Reaves over Giannis is unbelievable

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But if I could go get Giannis, I don't know what he talking about. If I can go get Giannis. Because you, I mean, we talking about, we talking about the Greek Freak here now. What we talking about?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I'm going after Giannis. I'm with you.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I'm going to get Giannis. That pick and roll, that pick and roll.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Just so everybody knows, I was going to send you a link in the chat. He is eligible for, it's reported by Yahoo and a bunch of people. Just so everybody knows, this is reported by Dan Woike and Sam Amick. Two pretty reputable writers in the NBA space.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' playoff performance as number one option is commendable
quotes.quote: 23 years, and then he talked about it yesterday, like not, he really thought about it. And this is why I didn't believe he could do it. And the fact that he did it, I give him a lot of props for that. He's never been a third option. First of all, the nigga ain't never been a second option. He's never done that in his life. And then for it to come back in the playoffs for him to be the number one option because Luka and AR went out, and then went to go win a series, you got to tip your cap to him. The motherfucker still can play.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Why would LeBron James return to play, he has nothing left to prove
quotes.quote: Let's ask this real question. LeBron is never going to be ass, right? He will never be ass on the basketball court. Why come back? What more do you have to actually do? What more, like, what is the true benefit of coming back? Put this in perspective though for you. You think he wants to leave out like that, getting swept? He won a series. He lost to a better team. I think he, I think he knows that. I understand that totally, but still that's LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James should go to Golden State for a fifth ring
quotes.quote: If he really wants five, if he really, if LeBron James really wants five, I don't know how he doesn't go to Golden State. If you want five, I don't know how you don't go to Golden State. If you want five, you go there. I think him and Jimmy, I think him Jimmy Butler, Draymond, and Steph makes a run at it.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James should team up with Steph Curry for a farewell run

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Somebody said send him to Detroit.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: That's a great fit, but he's not going to Detroit. Too young. Listen, it's perfect. There's no better iconic way for us to send Steph and Bron off. Let them play together.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Oh, you mean you said send Steph and Bron off? I'm like Steph's still playing another three years.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But for two of those, or he team up, or he team up with Kawhi.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: With the Clippers? The Clippers are going to full rebuild. I'm calling that right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He could go down to the street now, to Inglewood.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers were strong with Luka Doncic, not a bad team for LeBron
quotes.quote: He may not. And they just, and they, and they build around that and they get the pieces they need. Because you got to think about it, they were number three in the West, bro. It wasn't bad. When Luka and all them was, was played together, they, they won like nine, 10, 11 in a row, something like that. So it's not bad. It's not. You don't know though. You don't know. Luka was out. Luka was out.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need to make roster changes to contend, Golden State is an option
quotes.quote: I think you, I think you have to do something with Reaves, but even if you don't, you still got to go get some other pieces to make it work. That's still one of the teams. I give you three teams, Lakers is in there. I think Golden State is in there. Now who is that third team? Going to East Coast team is not an option. Yeah, he can go to Golden State and still get on the plane.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James with Kyrie Irving makes Dallas a championship contender

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Does Bron make sense for Dallas?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Dallas ain't bad. Dallas isn't bad, but I don't think Dallas can compete for a championship with LeBron. Actually, no, they got Kai and LeBron. Now they are a championship team. And if he's not taking max money.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: And if he not taking max money. What pick is Dallas getting this year?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Nine? If they get Bron, they're up there.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: They're not ahead of them though. They're like third or fourth in the West.
